name: Blackmoore's Legacy
summary: Gol'dir is free and carries news to Krusk in Tarren Mill. The Syndicate's leader, Aliden Perenolde, visited him and spoke of enslaving orcs who resist him. Perenolde also brought Elysa, a girl wearing the pendant the Warchief desires.

sections.title: A Visit to the Prisoner
sections.body: Gol'dir has news for Krusk after a visit from Aliden Perenolde, head of the Syndicate. Perenolde called himself lord of the land and said he meant to enslave the orcs who resist him. His father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned the same. Gol'dir sends you to carry this news to Krusk in Tarren Mill. He will follow after settling his own business where he is.

sections.title: Elysa's Pendant
sections.body: Perenolde also brought his mistress, a slight girl named Elysa. Around her neck hung the pendant the Warchief desires.

sections.title: Krusk's Answer
sections.body: Krusk answers Perenolde's threat with anger and vows the orcs will never submit. He sets resistance alongside the effort to recover the trinket the Warchief desires. Achieving either goal, he says, will bring the other within reach.

faq.answer: The orc Gol'dir gives this to you after you free him from the Syndicate.
Bring the news to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What did Aliden Perenolde reveal to Gol'dir?
faq.answer: Aliden Perenolde, head of the Syndicate, told Gol'dir he meant to enslave the orcs who resisted him, following plans made by his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore.

faq.q: What else did Gol'dir notice during the visit?
faq.answer: Perenolde brought his mistress, a girl named Elysa, who wore the pendant the Warchief desires around her neck.
You freed Gol'dir from the Syndicate.
